name: c-time-picker-1
title: Inline time panel
label: Inline Panel
description: Hour and minute columns rendered in place, with Now, Clear and a live readout.

guidance.bestFor: An always open panel set flush in a Card, where each column pick commits at once with no OK step
agentNotes: Replace the 14:30 preset `value` in `useState` with the stored meeting time, or `null` for none

whenNotToUse.when: A day and an hour chosen together in one card

name: c-time-picker-2
title: Popover picker
label: Popover
description: Outline trigger in a labelled field that opens hour and minute columns with Now, Clear and OK.

guidance.bestFor: The bare root with no children and no state, drawing its own trigger and popover and starting empty
agentNotes: Nothing reads the pick: wire `value` and `onValueChange`, or pass `name` so a native form submits it

whenNotToUse.when: A field where people type the hour and minutes by keyboard

name: c-time-picker-3
title: Typable time input
label: Typable Input
description: Type 930, 14:30 or 2:30 pm, or step through free times with the arrow keys.

guidance.bestFor: Keyboard first entry in a text field with a clock button, where typed times snap to 5 minute steps
agentNotes: Typed text commits on blur or Enter, never per keystroke, so `onValueChange` sees only finished times
`TimePickerInput` takes the root `id` in place of `TimePickerTrigger`, so never render the 2 side by side

whenNotToUse.when: Columns that stay open on the page with nothing to type

name: c-time-picker-4
title: 12-hour clock with seconds
label: 12-Hour Seconds
description: Hour, minute, second and AM/PM columns for a stream go-live time.

guidance.bestFor: Second level precision where the trigger reads 02:45:30 PM while the stored value stays 14:45:30
agentNotes: The `defaultValue` only seeds the picker; add `onValueChange` or a `name` to keep the go live time

whenNotToUse.when: A send hour where minutes and seconds do not matter

name: c-time-picker-5
title: Hour only
label: Hour Only
description: A daily digest send time picked by the hour in a settings row.

guidance.bestFor: A small fixed width trigger at the end of a settings Item row, with only hour and AM/PM columns
agentNotes: The digest hour is never saved; connect `onValueChange` to your notification settings to store it

name: c-time-picker-6
title: Steps and opening hours
label: Opening Hours
description: 15-minute steps limited to 08:30 to 17:30, with out-of-range hours disabled.

guidance.bestFor: An empty picker whose columns open on 08:30, the first allowed time, so an hour pick lands inside the window
agentNotes: Opening hours are hardcoded in `min` and `max`; load them per location before showing the picker
No handler reads the pick, so add `onValueChange` or a `name` before using it for a booking

whenNotToUse.when: Single booked slots or a lunch break blocked inside the open hours

name: c-time-picker-7
title: Unavailable slots
label: Unavailable Slots
description: 30-minute appointment slots with the lunch hour and booked times disabled.

guidance.bestFor: A lunch hour and a set of booked slots greyed out by one predicate, so hour 12 is disabled whole
agentNotes: Replace the hardcoded `BOOKED` set with your calendar's slots; once `isUnavailable` reads them, memoize it, since `isTimeDisabled` wants a stable function
The chosen slot stays inside the picker until you wire `onValueChange` or give the root a `name`

whenNotToUse.when: Opening hours alone, with no single slot blocked inside them

name: c-time-picker-8
title: Start and end time
label: Start & End
description: A meeting range where the end stays after the start and the duration updates.

guidance.bestFor: Two linked pickers where moving the start shifts the end by the same amount and earlier end slots are disabled
agentNotes: `start` and `end` are local state seeded with 09:00 and 10:00; lift them into your form to save the range
Ranges never cross midnight: the start stops at 23:30 and `LATEST_END` holds the end at 23:45

name: c-time-picker-9
title: Time zone label
label: Time Zone
description: Event time in the venue's time zone, shown in the trigger, with a footer that leaves out Now.

guidance.bestFor: Hand composed trigger content and footer: the value, a fixed zone name and the clock, then only Clear and OK
agentNotes: The `doors-open-zone` text is a fixed label that converts nothing; the value stays the venue's wall clock time
Trigger children replace the default content, so keep `TimePickerValue` in them or the value leaves the accessible name
The 19:30 `defaultValue` is never read back; add `onValueChange` or a `name` to store the doors time

whenNotToUse.when: A publish moment that needs a day picked as well as an hour

name: c-time-picker-10
title: Confirm before applying
label: Confirm Before Apply
description: Column picks stay a draft until OK, so a shift change applies once.

guidance.bestFor: Popover picks, Now and Clear held as a draft that closing throws away, with OK drawn as the primary button
agentNotes: `shiftStart` is local state seeded with 08:00; persist it from `onValueChange`, which fires only once a draft is confirmed

whenNotToUse.when: Picks that should apply the moment a row is clicked

name: c-time-picker-11
title: Localized labels
label: Localized
description: English, German, Chinese and Arabic labels, clocks and digits, with Arabic right to left.

guidance.bestFor: One stored value shown through 4 locale tabs, Chinese leading with the period and Arabic digits from a custom formatter
agentNotes: Languages live in the `LOCALES` array; add one there with its `hourCycle`, `dir` and `i18n` overrides

name: c-time-picker-12
title: Form field with validation
label: Form Validation
description: Native form field with a required check, an error, reset and the submitted value.

guidance.bestFor: A native form that reads the time from FormData on submit, swaps in a FieldError when empty and clears it on Reset
agentNotes: `onSubmit` only copies `deliveryTime` into local `booked` state; post it to your API there

name: c-time-picker-13
title: Date and time
label: Date & Time
description: Schedule a post with a calendar and time columns side by side in one card.

guidance.bestFor: A day and a time merged into one summary line, with 7 row columns, no footer and a Schedule button
agentNotes: `FIRST_MONTH` and `SUGGESTED_DAY` are fixed to October 2026; replace them with dates from your app
The Schedule `Button` only stores the summary in local `scheduled` state; send the date and `time` to your API there

whenNotToUse.when: A day of the month picked with no hour or minute
